name: Eternal Ltd. (Zomato, Blinkit, Hyperpure, District)
business_summary: Holding company of Zomato (food delivery, dining out/District), Blinkit (quick commerce, now inventory-led) and Hyperpure (B2B supplies). Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 24,138 cr (+78% y/y, boosted by Blinkit's shift to an inventory model), operating profit Rs 752 cr (3.1% margin), PAT Rs 125 cr, market cap Rs 3.44 lakh cr at ~700x trailing P/E. Value rests on Blinkit scale (3,500-5,000 store targets) and food delivery profitability; FIIs hold 33%.

exposures.mechanism: Blinkit is now the largest profit/value driver (inventory-led, revenue 24,138 cr in Q2 vs 13,590 cr a year ago largely from model change and 78% growth). +1 unit of q-comm adoption (faster order growth/higher AOV) -> Blinkit GOV +10% -> adj. EBITDA +~15% (store-level operating leverage) -> equity +8 at EV/MCap ~1.0, persistence 1.0 because it is the thesis; market already prices heavily (P/E 699).

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 profit +92% to Rs125 cr, revenue +78%; Blinkit Rs184 cr (adj. EBITDA per headline), targets 3,500-5,000 stores; missed estimates, shares -3.5% then flat
Q2 FY27 revenue 24,138 cr, OP 752 cr, PAT 125 cr; mcap 3,44,421 cr, P/E 699

exposures.mechanism: Food delivery and q-comm are urban discretionary/convenience categories. +5pp urban demand growth -> GOV growth +4-5pp -> contribution +6-8% at ~3% EBITDA/revenue margin with 40-50% incremental margin -> EBITDA +20%; persistence 0.3 and EV/MCap 1.0 -> +6.

exposures.mechanism: P/E ~700 and ROE <1%: value is nearly all long-dated growth. +25 bp -> discount-rate change on 25+ year duration ~ -2.5% (1/(r-g) with r-g~7%: 0.25/7=-3.5% damped 0.7). Empirical US 10y -1.46 (t -1.8) agrees in sign.

exposures.mechanism: FIIs hold ~33% and Eternal is the top-held consumer-internet name; +$5bn/qtr inflows -> relative rerating ~+3.5; FII holding moved 29.1% -> 33.0% between Jun and Sep-26 (screener).

exposures.mechanism: Beta 1.1-1.3 and 34% annual vol; +5 VIX points (risk aversion) -> market -4% with high-multiple growth beta ~1.3 and excess duration -> -2.5 after removing market component partially (pack: risk sentiment +0.67 t 1.2, opposite sign but insignificant, so weight shrunk to modest).

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 revenue 24,138 cr, OP 752 cr, PAT 125 cr; mcap 3,44,421 cr, P/E 699

exposures.mechanism: ~1/2 of delivery partner fleet runs on petrol bikes; rider payout ~6-7% of GOV, fuel ~10-12% of payout. +10% Brent -> fuel +4% -> payout inflation (partly compensated via per-order pay) -> costs +0.1% of GOV vs 3% adjusted EBITDA/GOV = -3%; persistence 0.3 -> -0.8. Pack -0.62 (t -0.9) agrees.

Labour codes introduce gig/platform-worker social security contributions (1-2% of turnover, capped at 5% of payouts to workers; model knowledge). At payouts ~6.5% of GOV the cap is ~0.3% of GOV (~10% of adjusted EBITDA) if levied in full -> equity -3 after pass-through of ~half via fees and persistence 1.0. Rules/implementation timing uncertain.

Liberalisation of FDI in inventory-based e-commerce would let foreign-owned rivals (Amazon Now, Flipkart Minutes, Zepto) hold inventory; Eternal is Indian-owned with an inventory model already. Share loss of 5% of Blinkit GOV at 20% decremental margin -> EBITDA -10% -> equity -3. Direction uncertain and event is speculative.

Blinkit imports electronics/GM, Hyperpure small; USD-priced cloud/ads. +3% USD/INR -> costs +0.2% of revenue -> -0.5. Pack shows +2.12 (t 1.1), opposite sign, insignificant (likely proxy for FPI/market-risk co-movement); not adopted.

exposures.mechanism: Restaurant menu inflation lowers delivery frequency; for Blinkit grocery inflation raises AOV. Net slightly negative: -0.5. Pack edible oil -4.37 (t -2.9) is the strongest empirical link but the mechanism is unclear (growth-vs-commodity-cycle rotation); only 12% of that weight adopted via this edge.
